annotations.title: NY schedule loss of use (SLU) award

description: A schedule loss of use award for one or more scheduled members: weeks on the schedule × loss of use % × the weekly rate for the date of accident, plus any protracted healing period credit (weeks at temporary total beyond the longest healing period, §15(4-a)). With prior_payments (0 if none) it adds the money moving, the 15% attorney fee rounded down to $5 (the OC-400.1 amount) and the net. With an employer reimbursement it splits the money and the fees between claimant and employer, exact to the cent; the fee on the reimbursement comes from the claimant's money when it is enough. Optional prior-counsel fee split. No 130-week credit on SLU. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core (the engine behind the app, the website calculators and the Pro Workspace); it never estimates. If an input is missing it returns status "missing" with every input still needed and calculates nothing. Returns the figures, the rate year used, the formulas with their citations (each flagged with whether it has been attorney-reviewed), and the not-legal-advice notice.

aww.description: Average weekly wage before the injury, in dollars (gross).

body_parts.description: Each scheduled member and its schedule loss of use percentage. Members: arm, hand, leg, foot, thumb, index/middle/ring/pinky finger, great toe, other toe, eye, one ear, both ears.

date_of_accident.description: Date of accident (injury), YYYY-MM-DD. Only a full date the user gave; never a guessed one.

employer_reimbursement.description: Optional employer reimbursement (REIMB ER) out of the award: { "amount": dollars } or { "amount_unknown": true } when it is still TBD. Needs prior_payments (0 if none).

prior_counsel_fees.description: Optional. Dollar amount of the fee apportioned to each prior counsel (one or two). The current attorney gets the rest of the fee.

prior_payments.description: Optional: dollars of this award already paid (0 if none). Adds the fee and net.

weeks_at_temporary_total.description: Optional: weeks paid at temporary total, for the protracted healing period credit.
